_meta.indication: IOMERVU is a radiographic contrast agent indicated for intra-arterial procedures (cerebral arteriography including IA-DSA in adults and pediatric patients; visceral and peripheral arteriography and aortography including IA-DSA in adults and pediatric patients; coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography in adults; radiographic evaluation of cardiac chambers and related arteries in pediatric patients) and intravenous procedures (CT of the head and body; CT angiography of intracranial, visceral, and lower extremity arteries; coronary CT angiography; and CT urography)
_meta.receipt_date: Received Dates: November 30 & December 14, 2023, respectively (NDA 216016 received December 14, 2023)

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study IOM-104A (coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography), a blinded re-read of studies 48,848-001A, -001B, -002A, and -002B
pivotal_trials.phase: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group clinical studies
pivotal_trials.design: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group studies; patients randomized to receive Iomervu 400 mg/mL (N=59) or iopamidol 370 mg/mL (N=58), or Iomervu 300 mg/mL (N=59) or ioversol 320 mg/mL (N=61)
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients undergoing coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Non-inferiority of Iomervu to comparator in the proportion of patients with adequate quality of opacification and anatomic visualization, using a 10% non-inferiority margin
pivotal_trials.n: 118 patients received Iomervu and 119 received iopamidol or ioversol in the full analysis population
pivotal_trials.result: At least 98% of image sets in both the Iomervu and comparator groups were rated as having adequate quality visualization (score 3-5) by all readers, with the lower bound of the 95% CI at least 91%; the upper limits of the 95% CIs for the between-group difference were within the 10% non-inferiority margin for all readers

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥0.5%) among 4,621 adult patients were feeling hot (2%), headache (1.2%), nausea (1%), chest pain (0.6%), back pain (0.5%), and vomiting (0.5%). Serious risks include life-threatening or fatal hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis, acute kidney injury, cardiovascular adverse reactions, and severe cutaneous adverse reactions.
target_moa: Iomeprol is an iodinated radiographic contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where the contrast agent is present following intravascular (intra-arterial or intravenous) administration, permitting radiographic visualization of internal structures through attenuation of X-ray photons
modality: Small molecule (iodinated radiographic contrast agent; iomeprol, molecular formula C17H22I3N3O8, molecular weight 777.09)

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION — intrathecal administration, even if inadvertent, may cause death, convulsions, cerebral hemorrhage, coma, paralysis, arachnoiditis, acute renal failure, cardiac arrest, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, hyperthermia, and brain edema; IOMERVU is for intra-arterial or intravenous use only

rems.type: A risk evaluation and mitigation strategy was not needed for this NDA

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held, and no external consultations were requested for this NDA

summary.text: IOMERVU was approved as a standard-review 505(b)(2) New Drug Application for iomeprol, a new molecular entity, with no accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track, orphan, or priority-review designations; approval was based on adequate and well-controlled studies and literature with no advisory committee meeting held.

citations.quote: Iomeprol has not been approved in the United States and is a new molecular entity (NME).
No advisory committee meeting was held, and no external consultations were requested for this NDA.

requirement.text: Quality CMC study for environmental assessment: submit a final environmental assessment report (fish early life-stage assay such as OECD 210); NDA 216016 has PMC 4662-1, final report submission date 01/31/2025

citations.quote: Each NDA has one CMC post marketing commitment (PMC) for environmental assessment. NDA 216016 has PMC 4662-1 and NDA 216017 has PMC 4661-1. The PMCs are identical in content.

PMC Description	Submit a final environmental assessment report
Final Report Submission Date	01/31/2025

Therefore, the EA team recommended the applicant conduct a fish early life-stage assay such as OECD 210, so as to enable the Agency to meet the requirement to determine whether approval of this drug application would significantly affect the quality of the human environment in the US, per 21 CFR 25.15(a).
